  "inclusion_criteria": "confirmed T2DM diagnosis >1 year; no change in diabetic treatment plan in previous 2 months; no major diabetic complication (e.g., coronary heart disease); chronic periodontitis (AAP criteria) with ≥1 mm mean clinical attachment loss (slight, moderate, and severe); ≥16 teeth",
  "exclusion_criteria": "systemic disease other than diabetes that could influence periodontal disease; systemic antibiotic administration within previous 3 months; pregnancy or lactation; refusal to provide written informed consent; active infection other than periodontitis; periodontal treatment in previous 12 months",

**Key extraction notes:**

- **Arm assignment**: This is a 3-arm RCT. Arm A = Treatment Group 1 (SRP at baseline + subgingival debridement at 3 months, n=45 randomised/42 analysed); Arm B = Control Group (no intervention, n=44 randomised/41 analysed). Treatment Group 2 (SRP + supragingival prophylaxis) is a second active arm not mapped to the standard A/B schema.
- **pct_female_arm_a**: 19 females / 42 total = 45.24%; **pct_female_arm_b**: 24 females / 41 total = 58.54% (derived from Table 1 M/F counts).
- **metabolic_control_level = fair**: Baseline HbA1c ~7.3% (arm A) and ~7.25% (arm B) fall in the 7–8% "fair" range.
- **tobacco_use**: Smokers were not excluded — current, former, and never-smokers were all enrolled (counts from Table 1).
- **alcohol_consumption**: Table 1 reports alcohol consumption as a count of drinkers (2 in TG1, 7 in control), with the paper classifying use as "drinking" vs. "not drinking."
